front.title: RADIUS attributes for National Security and Emergency Preparedness Service

abstract.t: This document defines RADIUS attributes for authorizing the use of Emergency Preparedness Communication Service (EPCS) priority access defined in IEEE 802.11be. These attributes allow an Identity Provider to indicate that an authenticated user is authorized for EPCS, enabling the Wi-Fi network provider to apply EPCS priority access to the user's Wi-Fi session. The attributes also support RADIUS accounting for Wi-Fi sessions in which EPCS priority access is used.
